title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments / Cool Flames Investigation with Gases
platform: International Space Station (ISS), Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR), ACME
summary: ISS tests of gas-fueled spherical diffusion flames using ethane, propane and n-butane, varying oxygen concentration, fuel dilution, flow and pressure in normal and inverse configurations to investigate hot-flame extinction and cool-flame combustion.
